summary.zh-CN: Conv+BN 融合是在推理前把 [[term:batch-normalization|Batch Normalization]] 已经固定的缩放和偏移吸收到[[term:convolution|卷积]]权重与偏置中，使[[term:runtime|运行图]]只执行一个等价卷积，不再单独调度 BN。
summary.en-US: Conv + BN folding absorbs the fixed scale and bias of [[term:batch-normalization|Batch Normalization]] into [[term:convolution|convolution]] weights and bias before inference, so the [[term:runtime|runtime graph]] executes one equivalent convolution without scheduling BN separately.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 它是推理态的代数等价改写：改变卷积参数，不改变网络函数，并删除独立 BN 的运行开销。
coreConclusion.en-US: It is an algebraically equivalent rewrite for inference: convolution parameters change, the network function does not, and the separate BN runtime cost is removed.
